picks.headline: Houdini 22 Is Out Now, Bringing Native Gaussian Splats, New UI, and More
picks.excerpt: SideFX shipped Houdini 22 with native Gaussian Splats (neural radiance-field capture), a redesigned UI, Copernicus and KineFX upgrades, and new rendering workflows for game and VFX production. Brings AI-adjacent neural-capture tooling into a core game-art content pipeline.
picks.rationale: SideFX's Houdini 22 lands native Gaussian Splats and a redesigned UI directly in a core game-art pipeline — an actionable first-party tooling release that changes how technical artists capture and build assets tomorrow.
